findings.message: part 'farfield_upstream' field 'U' declares BC type 'characteristicVelocityInletOutletVelocity' — verdict valid_foam_extend_only under fork 'main'; this BC exists in foam-extend but is absent from OpenFOAM-ESI mainline (the project's default Docker image opencfd/openfoam-default:2312). Solver will crash at boundary-field construction time with 'not found in valid types'. Suggested fix: Substitute 'freestream' (auto-direction-detecting flow per ESI canonical far-field velocity). See V29 evidence row.

part 'farfield_upstream' field 'p' declares BC type 'characteristicPressureInletOutletPressure' — verdict valid_foam_extend_only under fork 'main'; this BC exists in foam-extend but is absent from OpenFOAM-ESI mainline (the project's default Docker image opencfd/openfoam-default:2312). Solver will crash at boundary-field construction time with 'not found in valid types'. Suggested fix: Substitute 'freestreamPressure' (ESI canonical far-field pressure) or 'waveTransmissive' (ESI canonical upwind/downwind transmissive). See V29 evidence row.
